segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ זִמֵּן שְׁחוֹרִים וּמָצָא לְבָנִים, לְבָנִים וּמָצָא שְׁחוֹרִים, שְׁנַיִם וּמָצָא שְׁלֹשָׁה — אֲסוּרִים. שְׁלֹשָׁה וּמָצָא שְׁנַיִם — מוּתָּרִים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If, on the eve of a Festival, one «designated black» fledglings to be slaughtered, «and» on the following day «found white» ones in the dovecote, rather than the birds he had designated, or if one designated «white» ones to be slaughtered «and found black» ones, or if one designated «two» fledglings to be slaughtered «and found three, they are prohibited,» as these are not the same fledglings he had designated earlier. If, however, one designated «three» to be slaughtered «and found» only «two, they are permitted,» as it is presumed that one of the fledglings escaped.

segments.he: בְּתוֹךְ הַקֵּן וּמָצָא לִפְנֵי הַקֵּן — אֲסוּרִין, וְאִם אֵין שָׁם אֶלָּא הֵם — הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ מוּתָּרִים.
segments.en: If one designated them «inside the nest» and the next day he cannot find them there, «and he found» fledglings «before the nest, they are prohibited,» as they might be fledglings other than the ones he designated and left inside the nest. «But if there are only those» fledglings in the immediate vicinity, «they are permitted,» as it can be assumed that these are the ones he designated inside the nest.

moves.summary: rulings on changed color and number

positions.claim: changed color, more birds, or birds before the nest are prohibited; fewer birds, or only these near the nest, are permitted
